scope: Publicly identifiable AI-for-science work, deduplicated across arXiv/conference versions where appropriate. Bibliographic indexes are used for discovery; paper authorship and content are checked from primary documents. False-name matches in OpenAlex are excluded.
exclusions: General 3D point-cloud vision papers and AutoInt recommendation models are outside the AI-for-science corpus.
Duplicate conference/preprint versions are one work family. OAGNN later journal extension is linked to its public preprint.
Withdrawn2012.12124 is an early NERM version, not an additional current method.
OpenAlex false-name matches in drilling, orthopedics and energy-system scheduling are excluded after authorship checks.
A university lecture deck mentioning OmegaFold was retrieved during discovery, identified, and not counted as the primary paper.
review_depth: Editorial and visual review of task definition, model interface, argument structure, principal figures and evidence presentation. No independent reproduction of these papers is claimed.
